Discard.Title: Discard staged changes?
Discard.Body: The changes you staged in EMMA have not been saved. Closing the window discards them.

Disabled.Name: Disable EMMA
Disabled.Hint: Use Foundry's built-in Module Management window instead of EMMA. Takes effect immediately.

OlderVersions.Name: Show older versions
OlderVersions.Hint: How many versions before the one installed hypothetical mode offers in each version drop-down, and its reports consider. Installing an older version into an existing world is risky, as its data may not go back, so none are shown by default; one or two are enough to try rolling back an update. Warning: each version shown is judged against every other, so showing many older versions can make hypothetical mode noticeably slower.

BadgeChecks.Name: Badge checks
BadgeChecks.Hint: Whose checks the version badges show outside hypothetical mode. EMMA's check each module against the game system and its version, and an active module against the modules it requires and conflicts with, as well as the Foundry version. Foundry's own check the Foundry version alone, as its Module Management does, so may show a module as verified that will not work with your system: they may be inaccurate. Hypothetical mode always uses EMMA's.
BadgeChecks.Foundry: Foundry VTT's own checks (may be inaccurate)

AutoRecommended.Name: Automatically activate/deactivate recommended modules
AutoRecommended.Hint: When you activate a module in EMMA, also activate the modules it recommends, and deactivate them again with it. Required modules always follow the module that requires them.

Discard.Title: Discard your changes?
Discard.Body: The details you chose have not been saved. Closing the window discards them.

StartupChanges.Name: Changes since the world last ran
StartupChanges.Hint: When you open the world as its GM, EMMA compares the installation with what the world last ran with, as its record says, and tells you what changed, such as a module updated or uninstalled from the setup screen. A dialog only tells you; it changes nothing. A chat card is whispered to you alone, and stays in the chat log.
